description: This module allows configuring the default handler for a specific MIME type, to be used by applications built with the Gnome GIO API.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: Default handler set for the MIME type.

parameters.name: mime_type
parameters.description: MIME type for which a default handler is set.

examples:
- name: Set chrome as the default handler for https
  community.general.gio_mime:
    mime_type: x-scheme-handler/https
    handler: google-chrome.desktop
  register: result

return_values.name: handler
return_values.description: The handler set as default. Returned: success Sample: "google-chrome.desktop"

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: Version of gio. Returned: always Sample: "2.80.0"
